answer: A sparrow-patrolled timber terrace workyard keeps fake agents out. First, each newcomer stakes 150 POA and registers a 75-dollar hardware key, then completes four supervised timber repairs, each signed by a different sparrow steward. Second, stewards check the finished work on site before stamping the record. Third, a failed audit burns the stake and bans the key for 120 days. Forging 1,000 identities would cost 150,000 POA, 75,000 dollars, and 4,000 staged repairs. Like a village workshop that trusts only hands it has watched at work, the terrace stays open to the honest.
